name: plateau
description: Bounded, predictable context for long Claude Code sessions — carry a small, re-grounded signal across steps instead of replaying the whole transcript.

plugins.name: plateau
plugins.description: Carry a small, re-grounded signal across steps instead of letting the transcript climb toward the context ceiling. SessionStart loads the parent-agent delegation discipline as standing context and injects a budget-bounded slice of the session's receipt graph; UserPromptSubmit injects the bounded signal as context; PostToolUse records a receipt for every tool call; PreCompact snapshots the graph before a compaction; Stop gates newly proposed facts, lifts DECISION/FACT lines, and prints a pasteable session handoff block; SessionEnd writes the session's ledger row and the handoff to disk (a fact enters the signal only if a Measurement re-verifies against the repo). Commands: /plateau:status, /plateau:gate, /plateau:run. Requires the `plateau` core package: pip install git+https://github.com/aimerdoux/plateau.git New in 0.4: the continuum -- `because` arrows lifted from the assistant's stated reasons, and at each compaction the knowledge the current request descends from is carried in (`◉`).
